annotations.title: Wallet trading hours and liquidity history

description: When a wallet trades: settled DEX swaps by weekday and hour (UTC) over the swaps the site holds (`from`, `to` say which span; a very busy wallet is cut to its newest 10,000), the busiest hour, and the liquidity the wallet added and removed by pool (executed orders only; value in ADA at the pool price of the moment). Wallets without a stake key cannot be counted.

limit.description: How many pools to return (1-25, default 10).
